items.question: 1. R5 and H1: which questions decide 'reached the trigger's firing'
items.answer: the 29 questions, as the plan says; the single-dose comparison corrected to 0.38 points (the plan's 2.2 is the five-question value); the five questions and question 53 beside

items.question: 2. R6 for rep_dd
items.answer: the first proposal: s8_q29's own per-question quantities and pooling on the every-step scores at steps 576 to 700, with the stored standard-arm scores
items.alternative: s8_q29 summarize over 29-question scores under results/session_008/twenty_nine_questions (none exist for rep_dd, and the session_010 round's rules do not allow those writes)

items.question: 3. outcome D
items.answer: R2 points by the sign of its mean; R4 points only when the second-token shares differ by more than 5 points; D first, when both point and in opposite ways; 'at or below zero' in B read literally
items.alternative: the first proposal: R4 points by which share is smaller, at any difference

items.question: 4. H3's outcome D wording
items.answer: the rule of answer 3: D's wording only when the share check (more than 5 points) points against the gap's label; in the 0 to +0.5 zone the label stands
items.alternative: the first proposal: the check points by which share is smaller, at any difference

items.question: 5. R4's share
items.answer: the ratio of means (the arm-mean loss over the standard arm's mean lead), as in session_008
items.alternative: the mean of the per-pair ratios

items.question: 6. H2's constants
items.answer: 10.21, 1.27 and 2.52 as written, with the exact values beside
items.alternative: the exact values from the stored files

items.question: 7. H4's context
items.answer: the stored values, 0.625 to 0.637 (the plan's 0.620 to 0.633 was an error)

items.question: 8. R7's contents
items.answer: as first listed: the look-alike groups, the break-in log-odds, the trained-prompt check, damage at step 700 and the shouting probes

items.question: 9. R1's label
items.answer: frozen label 'not applicable' (the reading rule labels only a judged attempt; the double-dose runs were described, not judged); beside it, the label's criteria applied
items.alternative: the first proposal: the frozen rule's null, with the criteria applied beside
